adsense.note: No scripts, slots, cookies, or personalized ads are loaded. Founder approval and verified AdSense site readiness required before activation.

optimization.objective: Maximize compliant long-term page RPM and net ad revenue from Free Tools without harming usability

rollout.strategy: Responsive manual units on approved Free Tools pages only; no popups/interstitials; start with one well-separated unit outside each tool workspace.
Compare placements and density by revenue per 1000 pageviews, Core Web Vitals, and returning use; test Auto Ads only with verified page restrictions and format controls.
Prioritize high-quality organic discovery and genuinely differentiated utilities; continuously review RPM, coverage, country, and invalid-traffic risk.

restrictions: Never load ad scripts outside /tools/ and approved /tools/<slug>/ pages
Never place ads among controls, upload inputs, download buttons, or results
Never incentivize clicks or artificially inflate impressions
Never enable ads until Google site is Ready and consent compliance is confirmed
Maintain clearly visible Privacy Policy and usable mobile layout
